name: Tanaris terrain-aware minimap coverage cycle v4

coverage_policy.behavior: Follow the scan route; intercept only a confirmed bright live ore icon. Ignore dark underground icons and historical GatherMate pins.

limitations: ADT height/slope routing does not yet model doodads, fences, buildings, or liquid.
GatherMate records do not identify underground nodes; dark live minimap icons remain ignored.
The extended portions outside the human recording require live validation.
